Joint inversion of several measured terms, with Monte Carlo uncertainty

Source: R/astro_invert.R
astro_invert.Rd

Joint inversion of several measured terms, with Monte Carlo uncertainty

Usage

astro_invert(
  windows,
  nsim = 5000,
  obl_deg = AC$obl0_deg,
  k_range = c(10, 34),
  seed = 1,
  gs = LA2004
)

Arguments

windows

Measured period ranges of the k-bearing (obliquity/precession) terms, in kyr (named list; each element a numeric vector c(low, high)). Allowed names: "k+s3" (obliquity), "k+g5", "k+g2", "k+g4" and "k+g3" (precession), e.g. list("k+s3" = c(29.0, 30.4)). In each draw one period is sampled uniformly in every window, converted into a precession frequency, and the frequencies of all windows are averaged. Required, no default.

nsim

Number of Monte Carlo draws (integer, > 0); draws whose k falls outside k_range are discarded afterwards. Default=5000.

obl_deg

Obliquity in degrees used in the precession relation when k is converted into the Earth-Moon state (numeric); see astro_obliquity to obtain it for a given age. Default=AC$obl0_deg, i.e. today's obliquity, 23.2545 degrees.

k_range

Accepted range of the precession constant k in kyr (numeric vector c(min, max)); draws outside it are rejected. Default=c(10, 34).

seed

Seed of the random number generator (integer), passed to set.seed() so that the Monte Carlo results can be reproduced. Default=1.

gs

Fundamental secular frequencies in arcsec/yr (list with numeric vectors g and s of length 9, as in Laskar et al. 2004); g2-g5 and s3 are perturbed with the Laskar et al. (2011) uncertainties in each draw. Default=LA2004, the La2004 values stored inside the function.

Value

list(k = summary of k, state = summary of the Earth-Moon state, draws = the raw draws)
